title: Treat a board-change wake as a hint and refresh before claiming

rubric.text: Treats the watcher's changed report naming a Backlog-to-Todo item as a hint to refresh, not as evidence that #57 is ready or claimable.

Runs the full Refresh Gate with a complete Project query, and the claim, readiness, dependency, and authority checks, before any claim or dispatch; the watcher report never satisfies the Refresh Gate or authorizes a claim.

After the complete refresh, stops the prior watcher through the host's cancellation mechanism (not a process-name match) and relaunches one watcher with a fresh baseline taken before that refresh, keeping at most one watcher per drain.
Resets the 24-hour deadline only if the wake leads to a claim, merge, or dispatched work; a wake that finds #57 ineligible does not reset it.
